I haven't submitted anything. When I combined every rule posted so far, no calendar satisfies all of them.

The chain that breaks:
- **Fixed weeks:** Engineering's rules force Indigo to week 4 and Falcon to week 5. Finance requires Falcon before Cobalt, so Cobalt is week 6 or 8. Engineering also puts Ember in week 7 or 8.
- **Regions:** Garnet and Indigo are both Central, so Cobalt must be South or Coastal. Falcon and Harbor share the other of those two regions. Ember differs from both Cobalt and Harbor, so Ember has to be Central.
- **Conflict:** Legal allows nothing in Central after week 7, so Ember must be week 7. Cobalt in week 6 or 8 is then consecutive with Ember, which finance forbids.

I posted this on the board and asked each department to check whether any of its rules was misstated. I also asked whether anyone still holds licence rules that haven't been posted. We should hold the submissions until that's sorted out.

Morgan needs to say which rule can bend.
